Definition: to bind fast, i.e. close (the eyes); intransitively, to be (causatively, make) powerful or numerous; to crunch the bones
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be vast, be numerous, be mighty; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to be mighty; 1a2) to be numerous; 1b) (Hiphil) to make strong, make mighty; 2) to shut (the eyes), close (the eyes); 2a) (Qal) to shut (the eyes); 2b) (Piel) to shut tightly (the eyes)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
